component: Thunderbird compose FCC and sent-filter ordering

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned patch continues to the additional sent-folder copy when the primary copy is declined or fails. When sent filters run, an explicit promise waits for onStopOperation and its additional copy. The callback resolves or rejects that awaiter without throwing the same failure again through an ignored callback promise. Accepted code later factors and extends primary-copy recovery; this lesson preserves that source phase and claims no executed send or copy result.
title: Sent filters finish before the additional sent-folder copy completes
